notes.title: Official Korean Language Patch
notes.content:
Dear Nurse Love Addiction fans,

Thank you for all the support throughout the years. To make more people able to experience this title in their native language, we are happy to announce that we have added official Korean language support! 

We hope this can improve the overall experience, and if you have any suggestions on this update, please feel free to share them with us.

Cheers,

notes.title: Hatsune Miku VR update, new DLC, sale and huge giveaway!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32526477/b7058c944b684b73813de1139bf92ee9ae9a650e.png[/img]

First up, Hatsune Miku VR just got an update and new DLC bringing the total songs up to 19!

[h1]Update[/h1]
[list][*][b]Stage Select Screen[/b]
Added a costume and stick select (new Snow Miku & Negi available)
[*][b]Music Video mode[/b]
New song select screen: choose 8 songs to watch as a playlist with new costume select, stick select and stage select too.
[*][b]Sound enhancements[/b]
Rebalanced volume levels and changed in-game music to 3D sound.
[*][b]New free song[/b]
STELLA (by KotsubaneP)
[*][b]New free stage[/b]
Snow stage
[/list]

[h1]Sale[/h1]
And if that wasn't enough, we also have a sale on!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/707300/

[h1]Contest[/h1]
And to celebrate the update, DLC and launching on the Oculus store, we have a contest running on Gleam with prizes which include official Miku goodies, tickets to the Hatsune Miku Expo in Hong Kong in July and more!
Check the link below to enter:
https://gleam.io/bJt0s/hatsune-miku-vr-oculus-rift-experiences-launch

notes.title: Nurse Love Addiction will be at Anime Expo 2017!
notes.content:

We’ll be showcasing some of our most popular titles, along with a few surprises, so make sure to stop by our booth to experience them firsthand!

Make sure to stop by booth [b]# 4130[/b] to meet the Degica crew and play some awesome games! Hope to see you there. :)

notes.title: Nurse Love Addiction: We bring you a gift
notes.content:
[h1]NEW Illustrated Wallpaper[/h1]
Thank you all for playing Nurse Love Addiction!
As a special thank you to our players we have added a Steam-exclusive [b]original illustration by Hayase Akira[/b]!

To find it, please look in your installation folder as follows:
[list]
[*]Open your Steam Library
[*]Right-click on "Nurse Love Addiction"
[*]Open the Properties menu
[*]Click on the "Local Files" tab at the top of the menu
[*]Click "Browse Local Files..."
[*]The wallpaper is located in the "Wallpaper" folder
[/list]
Don't miss on this cute new illustration by Hayase Akira!
We hope you all enjoy the game too~

notes.title: Nurse Love Addiction: Degica Publisher Sale + Original Soundtrack!!!
notes.content:
[h1]Degica Publisher Sale Underway![/h1]
Steam is having a Degica publisher sale! Nurse Love Addiction is [b]30% off[/b] for a limited time. Moreover, as a token of our appreciation, we'd like to let you know that we will be giving away [b]a Steam exclusive illustration specially drawn by Akira Hayase![/b](^^)/ It will be added to your game folder soon! Now is your best chance to get this great visual novel!

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/sale/degica/]Check out all of Degica's games up to 90% off![/url]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25296213/2ee3a1a22a8d76ec92ac1691c35356c997d48f5f.png[/img]

[h1]Original Soundtrack is now available[/h1]
Thank you very much to all NLA fans for your patience! Today we're proud to announce that now "Nurse Love Addiction - Original Soundtrack" is available as a DLC! It includes not only the popular theme song "Sunny Place" but also all of the BGM you enjoyed during the game play. Now you can bring all 15 tracks anywhere you like with you!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/543210
Grab it for 10% off during the first week!

[h1] Giveaway![/h1]
We’re also running a giveaway this weekend with [b]$1000 in Steam Wallet Codes[/b] up for grabs! You can get all of details and enter here: http://promo.degicagames.com/weekend-deal-giveaway/

notes.title: Nurse Love Addiction: Trading Cards are Here!!!!
notes.content:
Hi Everyone,
We've got a very exciting announcement for you today!

Steam Trading Cards for Nurse Love Addiction are now available!!

They took a little bit longer to put together than we thought so thanks very much for your patience!

[h1]Here's a quick overview of what's available to collect:[/h1]
- 6 badges
- 10 Trading Cards
- 5 Profile Backgrounds
- 5 emoticons

A huge thanks to everyone who has checked out/played Nurse Love Addiction since release! 

We're a few Steam reviews short of 100 so if you haven't left one yet it would be greatly appreciated :D

Bye For Now,

The Nurse Love Addiction Team
